entities.summary: Robert Thomas Delaney is an American comedian, actor, writer, and activist. He is best known for co-creating and starring as Rob Norris in the sitcom Catastrophe (2015–2019), and Peter Wisdom in the superhero films Deadpool 2 (2018) and Deadpool & Wolverine (2024).
